admin_lot_size_revert.help.parcel_id: Reverts the lot size a user entered for this lot. The entry stays in the history and the lot shows the City lot record again.
admin_lot_size_revert.errors.type: This value has the wrong type.
admin_lot_size_revert.errors.pattern: Use the City parcel id: letters, numbers, - or _ (up to 20).
admin_lot_size_revert.errors.additional_: This form sent a field it does not know.
admin_lot_size_revert.state.error: Nothing was reverted. Check the parcel id: the lot must have an entered lot size.
admin_lot_size_revert.state.hit: Reverted. The lot shows the City lot record again.
admin_lot_size_revert.state.unauthorized: Your session has expired or you are not an admin. Sign in again to revert entries.
admin_lot_size_revert.state.offline: You are offline. Revert the entry when the connection returns.
